processing_notes: Validated zero-transmission period 2000-2006. MSF 2007 intervention report and WHO non-endemic status confirmation indicate no documented cholera transmission preceding the 2007 Pointe-Noire/Brazzaville outbreak. Evidence type: Documented_Absence corroborated by absence from WHO AFRO surveillance bulletins and confirmation of non-endemic status. Surveillance system status during absence: operational national-level surveillance (sante.gouv.cg historic bulletins) with no cholera notifications.
retracted_reason: CONTRADICTED. Asserted sCh=0 for 2000-01-01..2006-12-31, but (a) WHO GHO indicator CHOLERA_0000000001 for SpatialDim COG gives 2000 = 9 cases and 2006 = 175 cases, mirrored by data/COG/cholera_data_jhu.csv Index 4900 and 4902 (WHO Annual Cholera Report UID 309); (b) WER 'Cholera, 2000' Africa table lists 'Congo ... 9 ... 2'; (c) WHO Country Cooperation Strategy Congo 2009-2013 records cholera epidemics at Brazzaville and Pointe-Noire in 2001 and a cholera epidemic in the last quarter of 2006; (d) data/COG/cholera_data_ai.csv itself holds positive 2006 rows (Pointe-Noire 6452 cases from 2006-11-01). Three of the seven covered years had cholera. Replaced by a correctly bounded 2002-01-01..2005-12-31 zero row citing the WHO CCS statement 'aucun cas n'a ete notifie sur l'ensemble du territoire de 2001 a 2005'.

source: WHO AFRO Cholera Congo 2011 DREF Context Report
processing_notes: Validated zero-transmission period 2008-2010. WHO AFRO regional surveillance between the documented 2007 Pointe-Noire outbreak and the 2011 nationwide outbreak shows no documented cholera transmission. Evidence type: Documented_Absence from WHO surveillance bulletins; IFRC DREF MDRCG009 context report confirms 2011 as the next outbreak event. Surveillance system status: operational under MoH IDSR framework.
retracted_reason: CONTRADICTED. Asserted sCh=0 for 2008-01-01..2010-12-31, but WHO GHO indicator CHOLERA_0000000001 for SpatialDim COG gives 2008 = 156 cases / 4 deaths and 2009 = 93 cases / 0 deaths, mirrored by data/COG/cholera_data_jhu.csv Index 4904 and 4905 (WHO Annual Cholera Report UID 309); and the WHO Country Cooperation Strategy Congo 2009-2013 states 'Depuis le mois de fevrier 2008, une epidemie de cholera sevit dans le departement de la Bouenza, au total 98 cas, dont 1 deces, ont ete enregistres du 02 fevrier au 30 juin 2008.' Two of the three covered years had cholera. Replaced by a 2010-01-01..2010-12-31 Inferred_Absence row at lower confidence.
